notes: Always read control files before work. Default simulator: Habitat-Lab/Habitat-Sim. Prefer HM3D small split or Habitat demo scene. Do not switch simulator silently. Gate 0 remains available through the opening_preexp conda environment and reusable activation scripts at scripts/bootstrap_env.sh and scripts/activate_env.sh. To match the official Habitat conda packages, the runtime inside opening_preexp has been retargeted to Python 3.9.19; Habitat-Sim 0.3.3 and Habitat-Lab 0.3.3 are installed, HM3D example_full has been downloaded under data/, and scripts/check_env.py now reports PLAN_A_READY. T0 is complete: scripts/run_minimal_trajectory.py records a reproducible 24-step random trajectory in the HM3D example scene, scripts/export_minimal_observations.py exports RGB/depth/semantic example images, and scripts/export_minimal_topdown_map.py renders the top-down path figure at outputs/figures/minimal_demo.png. T1 is complete: scripts/generate_tasks.py now writes a balanced formal task set to outputs/tasks/tasks.json with 24 tasks, task-type coverage room_exist=8 and near_exist=16, label distribution yes/no = 12/12, explicit gt_source metadata, unified task_spec fields, and gt_answer_bool for downstream consumers. scripts/validate_tasks.py generates outputs/logs/task_validation.md and currently reports PASS with zero validation failures. For manual answer checking, scripts/browse_scene.py now provides an interactive browser for the current HM3D scene with RGB/depth/semantic switching, task cycling, HUD toggle, and screenshot capture. The browser was further refined to use a compact left-top HUD, a thinner help strip, and a higher default render resolution of 960x720 so the scene is less blurry and the overlay blocks less of the view; outputs/figures/scene_browser_preview.png verifies the updated browser can render the scene with task HUD overlay. T2 is complete: src/memory/occupancy_map.py builds a minimal trajectory-driven spatial memory with explored/free/occupied/frontier cells plus visit counts, src/memory/object_memory.py accumulates HM3D GT semantic objects across trajectory poses with category, region_id, bbox geometry, first/last seen step, observation counts, observed step ids, and min distance, outputs/runs/object_memory_dump.json provides the formal accumulated memory artifact with 37 entries across 21 categories and 25 pose updates, and scripts/export_object_memory_figure.py renders outputs/figures/object_memory_overview.png so object distribution, category counts, and first/last seen ranges can be inspected visually. T3.1 through T3.4 are now complete: src/policies/base_policy.py defines the shared policy interface, src/policies/rollout_utils.py centralizes task loading plus rollout logging helpers, src/policies/random_policy.py implements a runnable random baseline, src/policies/frontier_policy.py implements a runnable frontier baseline, src/policies/task_aware_policy.py implements task-aware frontier scoring with live object-memory updates, and src/policies/task_parser.py now normalizes raw tasks into a ParsedTask representation with explicit relation, room_label, target_category, anchor_category, semantic_hints, room_keywords, and hint_categories. The task-aware policy now consumes ParsedTask instead of parsing raw task_spec inline. Current smoke rollouts on the same first formal task show random collision_count=11, frontier collision_count=6, and task_aware collision_count=1. Task-aware currently scores frontier candidates as observed_relevance_score + scene_prior_score - frontier_distance_penalty * frontier_distance, where observed_relevance_score comes from the accumulating object memory and scene_prior_score comes from GT semantic objects matching the parsed hint categories. Both memory modules remain minimal: occupancy uses x-z grid discretization and path tracing around agent poses without depth-derived obstacles, while object memory uses object-center plus FOV/radius geometry as a visibility heuristic instead of pixel-level semantic fusion. Repository hygiene support is also in place: the root .gitignore now ignores local environments, downloaded datasets, external clones, generated outputs, caches, and local scratch notes while keeping source and control files trackable, and scripts/push_repo.sh now provides a reusable push helper that can configure origin once and then run add+commit+push in one command. Because the current HM3D example scene does not expose reliable native room labels, room_exist currently uses region-object keyword heuristics and near_exist uses same-region cooccurrence heuristics. habitat_baselines is still absent and some early non-T0 packages such as pandas/open3d need to be backfilled later if required.
